name: Breakthrough
source:
I'm in love with an angel. 
She ruled my heart from the moment I saw her. 
How long has it been, I wonder... 

They say Jesus loves everyone, but I feel like the exception. 
Christmas has always been a special day. 
Special in that it's just awful. 

Every year's unlucky. I have no good memories.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE192614.html]DLsite English[/url]]
